snippet.title: Bad Magpie | Official Announce Trailer | XBOX Games Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
You are a magpie with one wing, a missing flock, and an unhealthy obsession with a fallen star. Steal shiny trinkets, cause chaos, and stick your beak where it doesn’t belong.

Bad Magpie is coming to XBOX Series X|S and XBOX on PC as an XBOX Play Anywhere title and with XBOX Game Pass in 2027.
